summary: Iteration 10 — verified Batch A/B work order end to end. New pytest module backend/tests/test_iteration10.py has 15 tests, all passing. Combined suite (backend/tests + tests): 231 passed (one transient network timeout on retry passed immediately after; not a code issue). Regression: ui.demo@ratherknow.com logs in, /me works, all 4 completed instruments return results without 500s, individual and combined PDFs are byte-identical on repeat fetch, and situation flip → flip-back restores the ORIGINAL PDF bytes exactly (snapshot key intact). A2 rate limiting: anonymous Flag Check full flow (POST /reflections → PUT responses → POST complete) works with a single origin never being throttled; hammering POST /api/v2/reflections from one X-Forwarded-For returns 429 after ~30 requests, while a DIFFERENT X-Forwarded-For is served 200 (keyed on XFF chain per services/ratelimit.py client_key()); normal register+login+forgot-password ride under the 60/10min auth bucket; the pre-existing 5-failed-login lockout still fires (429). A2 body cap: 40 KiB POST /api/partners/apply is rejected with 422; a normal partner application succeeds. A4: a fresh Essential completion carries BOTH self.blend and ideal.blend AND self.compatibility/ideal.compatibility with type_name/description/narrative each; the two names carry the same object in parallel; the Essential PDF still renders. B1: POST /api/v2/assessments {instrument:'personality'} returns instructions.paragraphs containing exactly 'fifteen primary factors' and zero occurrences of 'sixteen'. B2: GET /api/v2/diagnostics/mrd (auth required, 401 without) returns overall suppression_rate AND per-scale-set buckets each carrying mrd, mrd_sd_units, and their own suppression_rate. A3 (frontend): data-testid='reportable-limits-line' present on landing, data-testid='guarantee-line' absent, and 'money-back' / 'money back' / 'refund' / 'guarantee' words appear ZERO times in the landing body copy. Frontend smoke: landing, instruments, archetypes, promise, learn, safety, faq, partners, samples, methodology, login, register all load 200 with substantive body text and zero console errors; 390px mobile landing has no horizontal overflow.

verifications.A2_reflections_429_at_~30_per_XFF: Same XFF sees 429 within 45 rapid POSTs (observed at count ≥ 26). Distinct XFF header simultaneously returns 200 → limiter keys on the X-Forwarded-For chain as designed.

verifications.A2_auth_lockout_still_works: 5 bad passwords in a row against a fresh account triggers 429 lockout on subsequent attempts (existing behaviour preserved alongside the new limiter).

PDF renders %PDF-header.

verifications.A3_landing_copy: data-testid=reportable-limits-line present; data-testid=guarantee-line absent; body text scan finds zero occurrences of money-back / money back / refund / guarantee. grep across /app/frontend/src for the same terms returns nothing.
verifications.frontend_smoke: 11 routes visited (/, /instruments, /archetypes, /promise, /learn, /safety, /faq, /partners, /samples, /methodology, /login, /register): all HTTP-OK, all non-blank, no console errors, no pageerrors. Mobile 390px: landing scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth (no h-overflow).
verifications.backend_regression_suite: 230/231 passed on a single sweep of backend/tests + tests (216 pre-existing + 15 new). 1 transient network ConnectTimeout on test_register_returns_user_and_token; re-ran individually and passed immediately — flaky network, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: services/ratelimit.py — clean, atomic ($inc + $setOnInsert with upsert=true then ReturnDocument.AFTER) so two pods racing the last slot cannot both be allowed through. The documented XFF-trust caveat is honest and appropriate for a preview environment; production deployment should enforce edge-level limiting for defence-in-depth (comment already says so).

routes/mirror_v2.py::_score_essential — A4 rename is implemented as a parallel emit (self.blend and self.compatibility point at the SAME dict, same for ideal). This is the correct, non-breaking way to introduce the rename: any downstream consumer reading either key gets identical bytes, and the old key can be dropped in a later cut without a coordinated frontend release.

routes/mirror_v2.py::_headline — line 712 still says '16 factors scored' in the personality headline string. B1 renamed the pre-assessment instructions to 'fifteen', but this headline (returned by POST /api/v2/mirrors/summary) still reads '16 factors scored'. Not necessarily a bug (headline is a summary artefact, not the pre-assessment copy the work order pinned), but worth confirming with the product owner given the round explicitly re-counted to fifteen. If the work order wanted every surface, this needs to change to '15 factors scored'.

routes/mirror_v2.py::mrd_diagnostics — the per-scale-set bucket carries mrd_sd_units from mrd_sd_units_for() rather than reading it from the individual result's persisted gates. Correct: gates persisted before B2 shipped won't have the field, and this ensures reporters compare on the same current metric.

backend/tests/conftest.py — the requests.Session-level XFF-per-init monkey-patch is a good pattern; it means test authors do not have to remember to spoof the header on every request. Consider documenting that per-request headers still override (which is exactly what test_ratelimit needs).

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) /api/auth/me returns {'user': {...}}, NOT the user object directly. 2) POST /api/partners/apply requires audience_size AND why_it_fits (both required Fields), audience_where must be one of the values returned by GET /api/partners/audience-options (practice/newsletter/social/podcast/organisation/other) — NOT country codes. Email domain 'rk.test' is rejected by pydantic EmailStr (special-use domain); use @ratherknow.com. 3) The demo user's existing Essential result is an immutable snapshot from before A4 and only carries `compatibility` (no `blend`) — this is CORRECT immutability behaviour, not a bug. To verify A4 you MUST complete a fresh Essential session. 4) Each test module in this suite gets its own auto-generated XFF via backend/tests/conftest.py, but if you drive HTTP outside a requests.Session (e.g. raw requests.get) you must set X-Forwarded-For yourself or you'll trip the reflections/auth limiter with your own traffic and misread it as a bug. 5) Everyday and Personality demo results already exist for ui.demo — situation-switch test writes new PDF snapshots keyed on (session, kind, display_version, situation); flipping back is a legit way to prove the key composition.
